ei.subject: ReadingPower유형편완성

fullPassage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa ①<u>should go far beyond</u> the purchase of oil and minerals, and ②<u>require</u> sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ③<u>ranks high</u> in this category. The majority of Africans today ④<u>make their living</u> as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② require → requires: 주어 'Western involvement'는 단수이므로 3인칭 단수 동사 requires가 와야 함. require는 복수/원형으로 단수 주어와 일치하지 않음.
det.analysis:
✅ ① should go far beyond: 원문 일치 (조동사 + 동사원형 + 부사 + 전치사)
❌ ② require → requires (단수 주어 Western involvement + 단수 동사 requires)
✅ ③ ranks high: 원문 일치 (3인칭 단수 동사 + 부사)
✅ ④ make their living: 원문 일치 (복수 주어 The majority of Africans + 복수 동사)
det.tip: 주어 단수 ↔ 동사 단수 일치. involvement는 추상 명사 단수.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today ①<u>make their living</u> as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries ②<u>are a serious obstacle</u> to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they ③<u>are able to marketing</u> their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they ④<u>cannot compete</u> with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ are able to marketing → are able to market: 'be able to + 동사원형'이 정형. marketing(동명사/현재분사)은 to 다음에 올 수 없음.
det.analysis:
✅ ① make their living: 원문 일치 (3인칭 복수 + 동사원형)
✅ ② are a serious obstacle: 원문 일치 (be동사 + 명사 보어)
❌ ③ are able to marketing → are able to market (be able to + 동사원형. marketing은 오류)
✅ ④ cannot compete: 원문 일치 (조동사 + 동사원형)
det.tip: be able to + 동사원형 = ~할 수 있다. to 다음 동사원형 필수.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers ②<u>who receive state subsidies</u> ③<u>to plant</u>, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually ④<u>stopping</u> these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and ①<u>to give African farmers</u> their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ stopping → stop: 'It is up to ~ to V'에서 to부정사의 동사원형이 와야 함. 또한 마지막 'and to give'와 병렬 구조이므로 to stop이 자연스러움 (to 생략 가능 — 동사원형 stop).
det.analysis:
✅ ① who receive state subsidies: 원문 일치 (관계대명사 + 동사 + 목적어)
✅ ② to plant: 원문 일치 (to부정사 — 보조금 목적)
❌ ③ stopping → stop (gradually stop — to부정사의 동사원형 자리. -ing 형태 불가)
✅ ④ to give African farmers: 원문 일치 (and로 연결된 to부정사 병렬)
det.tip: It is up to A to V = A에게 V할 책임이 있다. to + 동사원형.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires ①<u>sacrifices</u> from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious ②<u>advantage</u> to fair competition. African farmers earn very ③<u>low</u> per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot ④<u>compete</u> with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② advantage(이점) → obstacle(장애물): 부유국의 보조금은 아프리카 농부들에게 공정 경쟁을 막는 '장애물'. '이점'으로 바뀌면 글의 핵심 비판 논리(보조금 = 불공정)가 무너짐.
det.analysis:
✅ ① sacrifices: 원문 일치 (부유국이 '희생'을 감수해야 함)
❌ ② advantage → obstacle (보조금은 공정 경쟁의 '장애물'. '이점'은 정반대)
✅ ③ low: 원문 일치 (아프리카 농부의 '낮은' 시간당 임금)
✅ ④ compete: 원문 일치 (보조금 받는 농부들과 '경쟁할' 수 없음)
det.tip: obstacle to fair competition = 공정 경쟁의 장애물. 보조금 비판의 핵심 단어.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all ①<u>wealthy</u> countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of ②<u>agricultural</u> subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually ④<u>increase</u> these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about ③<u>free</u> trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ increase(늘리다) → stop(중단하다): 글쓴이는 부유국이 보조금을 '점진적으로 중단'해야 한다고 주장. '증액'은 글의 결론과 정반대.
det.analysis:
✅ ① wealthy: 원문 일치 (부유한 국가들)
✅ ② agricultural: 원문 일치 (농업 보조금)
✅ ③ free: 원문 일치 (자유 무역)
❌ ④ increase → stop (gradually stop these subsidies — '중단'이 결론. 증액은 정반대)
det.tip: gradually stop these subsidies = 보조금 점진적 중단. 글의 처방 핵심 단어.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural __________ ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: subsidies(보조금): 'farmers who receive state ___ to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce'. 부유국 농부들이 받는 것 = 정부의 '보조금'. 글 전체 비판 대상.
det.analysis:
❌ ① minerals: 광물은 농업과 무관
✅ ② subsidies: 글 전체 비판 대상 = 농업 '보조금'
❌ ③ wages: 임금은 농부의 수입이지 '받는 것' 부조와 다름
❌ ④ prices: 가격은 시장의 결과지 농부가 '받는' 정부 지원 아님
det.tip: receive state ___ + plant/harvest/export/market: 정부가 농민에게 주는 보조 = subsidies.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious __________ to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: obstacle(장애물): 'subsidies in rich countries are a serious ___ to fair competition'. 보조금이 공정 경쟁에 '장애물'이라는 글의 핵심 비판.
det.analysis:
❌ ① chance: '기회'는 장애물의 반의어 — 의미 충돌
✅ ② obstacle: 보조금 = 공정 경쟁의 '장애물' (글 비판 논리)
❌ ③ purchase: '구매'는 장애물 의미 없음
❌ ④ sacrifice: '희생'은 부유국 행위지 경쟁 방해물 아님
det.tip: obstacle to N = N에 대한 장애물. 글쓴이의 비판 핵심 단어.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 아프리카 농부들의 시간당 임금은 'very low'(매우 낮음)로 명시. 부유국 농부보다 '높다'는 선지는 본문과 정반대.
det.analysis:
✅ ① S1: should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals — 일치
✅ ② S2: ranks high in this category — 일치
✅ ③ S3: The majority of Africans ~ make their living as commercial farmers — 일치
❌ ④ S4: African farmers earn very low per-hour wages — 낮음 (선지 '높다' 반대)
det.tip: very low per-hour wages = 매우 낮은 시간당 임금. '높다'는 정반대 함정.

ch: 글쓴이는 서구의 아프리카 개입이 자원 구매 이상이어야 한다고 본다.
농업 보조금 문제는 이 분야에서 비중 있게 다뤄야 할 사안이다.
오늘날 아프리카 인구 대다수는 상업 농부로 생계를 꾸린다.
아프리카 농부들은 부유국 농부들보다 시간당 임금이 더 높다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① S5: receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce — 보조금이 생산~판매 전 단계에 쓰임을 명시.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 보조금이 plant/harvest/export/market 전 과정에 사용 — 일치
❌ ② 글쓴이는 'gradually stop'(점진적 중단) — '즉시 전면 폐지' 다름
❌ ③ S5: cannot compete — 동등 경쟁 불가 (반대)
❌ ④ 글쓴이는 자유 무역을 '진심으로 믿는다면 보조금 중단해야' — 자유 무역 원칙 옹호
det.tip: subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market = 전 농산 단계 보조.

ch: 부유국 농부들이 받는 보조금은 농산물의 생산·가공·수출·판매에 모두 쓰인다.
글쓴이는 부유국이 보조금을 즉시 전면 폐지해야 한다고 주장한다.
아프리카 농부들은 부유국 농부들과 동등한 조건에서 경쟁할 수 있다.
글쓴이는 자유 무역 원칙은 실제로 지킬 필요가 없다고 본다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① S1: 'requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries' — '모든' 부유국이 부담해야 함. '일부'는 본문과 반대.
det.analysis:

✅ ② S4: tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas — 일치
✅ ③ S6: gradually stop these subsidies — 일치
✅ ④ S6: if they really believe their own words about free trade — 일치
det.tip: all wealthy countries = 모든 부유국. '일부' 또는 '서구만' 함정 주의.

ch: 아프리카 개입 비용은 부유국 일부에만 부담되어야 한다.
아프리카 농부들이 시장에 내놓는 작물에는 차·면화·카카오·바나나가 포함된다.
글쓴이는 부유국이 보조금을 점진적으로 중단해야 한다고 본다.
글쓴이는 부유국이 자유 무역에 대한 자신들의 말을 진정으로 믿는지 묻는다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주제: 부유국 농업 보조금이 아프리카 농민의 공정 경쟁을 막는 '장애물'이 되며, 점진적 중단이 필요하다.
det.analysis:

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>if they really believe their own words</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'if they really believe their own words [about free trade]' — 부유국이 자유 무역에 대한 자신들의 약속을 '말로만'이 아니라 '진정으로' 믿고 실행한다면, 즉 보조금을 중단할 것이라는 풍자적 조건.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 자유 무역 약속을 진정 실행 — 본문 핵심 함의
❌ ② 다른 나라의 말 신뢰: their own words는 자국의 말
❌ ③ 자국 언어 보호: words는 약속·발언
❌ ④ 새로운 협정 체결: 본문 함의 아님
det.tip: their own words about free trade = 자유 무역에 대한 자신들의 (말뿐인) 약속. 풍자적 조건.

ch: 부유국이 자유 무역 약속을 진정으로 실행한다면

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for <u>them</u>, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>them</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle' — 앞 절의 'The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers'의 commercial farmers를 가리킴.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 부유국 농부: 비교 대상이지 them의 지시 아님
❌ ② 광물·석유: 무관
✅ ③ 아프리카 상업 농부: 앞 절의 commercial farmers (the majority of Africans)
❌ ④ 정부 보조금: them은 사람 복수, 보조금은 비대상
det.tip: for them, X is an obstacle: them = 장애물의 영향을 받는 사람들 = 아프리카 농민.

det.analysis:

det.tip: they really believe their own words: 약속을 한 주체 = the rich countries.
